body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: Aiming to give clarity to the state’s future technological direction, the state government’s department of electronics and information technology was renamed the department of information technology, artificial intelligence and future technologies, on Saturday. “The renaming marks a significant step towards aligning Kerala’s technology governance more closely with rapidly emerging technology sectors globally.
